text.offer: Ah, my loyal servant. I require you to collect all taxes due from Frisconar, the apothecary of Tos, and bring them back to me.
text.progress: Duke Akardius has commanded you to collect taxes from Frisconar. Return quickly with the full amount.
text.complete: You have done well. You have carried out my task, and remain in my favor.

steps.brief: Oh, yes, my tax money for the Duke... Here it is.
steps.objective: Bring the taxes to Duke Akardius
